item.title: Stuck: Interview Podcast
item.description: Conversational deep-dive with Chris on the seasons framework. $30B president cold open, three myths, anti-circle, four seasons with vernalization, Mohs surgery, dream house, granny shot, simmering six.

item.title: Culture: Narrative Keynote
item.description: Culture is a direction, not a destination. The three elements (communicate, change, connect), faith-hope-love as culture framework, nine risk factors.

item.title: AI: Narrative Keynote
item.description: Imagine. Discern. Build. The three capacities AI can't replace: SEE (Ginosko), SWEAT (Phronesis), STAY (Koinonia). The washing machine close.

item.title: Stuck: Narrative Keynote
item.description: You are not stuck. You are in a season. Four seasons framework (Fall, Winter, Spring, Summer), IDK-cubed diagnostic, vernalization.

item.title: Lead for Impact: Narrative Keynote
item.description: Name the pain. Hold the line. Stay in the room. The 3% that shapes 97% of your culture. Impact = Right Action + Right Motive.
